skill.name: image-generator
skill.description: Guides agents through Gemini browser image generation for instructional visuals, using creative briefs, six quality gates, iteration, batching, and lesson embedding.
skill.summary: Guides Gemini browser image generation for teaching visuals with quality gates and batch workflows.
skill.author: 92Bilal26

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences and prompt examples. Real risks remain for launching a local browser-use server, copying generated assets with Bash, sending prompts to Gemini, and suppressing review prompts during batch mode.

remediation.issue: Local script execution is documented without explicit trust or setup checks.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before starting the browser-use server and document the exact script path, purpose, and expected local effects.

remediation.issue: Generated assets are copied into application directories through Bash workflow steps.
remediation.suggestion: Constrain copy operations to user-approved project paths and confirm before overwriting or embedding files.

remediation.issue: Creative briefs are sent to Gemini through browser automation.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose third-party processing and ask users to review sensitive or proprietary content before submitting prompts.

remediation.issue: Batch mode discourages intermediate review prompts.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for batch size, stop conditions, and approval rules before starting, and require review before file writes or after repeated quality failures.

semantic_findings.title: Autonomous Batch Execution Suppresses Review Prompts

content.user_title: Generate Teaching Visuals With Quality Gates
content.value_statement: Teams need consistent instructional images without slow prompt tuning or uneven quality. This skill provides a Gemini browser workflow with briefs, quality gates, iteration, and organized embedding.
actual_capabilities: Structures image requests as creative briefs with story, intent, metaphor, composition, colors, and typography.
Guides browser navigation to Gemini image creation and repeated prompt submission.
Defines six pass/fail gates for visual quality and instructional clarity.
Provides principle-based feedback patterns for failed quality gates.
Supports batch generation with new chats, progress logs, checkpoints, and final summaries.
Directs download, folder organization, and lesson embedding for approved images.
limitations: Requires browser-use and access to Gemini; it does not include a local image model.
Quality checks rely on visual inspection by the agent.
It is not intended for stock photos or decorative images.
Batch mode may continue without intermediate review unless the user sets limits.

use_cases.title: Create course chapter illustrations
use_cases.description: Generate images that explain lesson concepts with controlled colors, typography, and teaching clarity.

use_cases.title: Build visual sets for learning modules
use_cases.description: Run a batch workflow that creates, checks, downloads, organizes, and embeds multiple approved visuals.

use_cases.title: Refine technical diagrams for learners
use_cases.description: Use quality gates and principle-based feedback to improve diagrams for spelling, hierarchy, layout, and comprehension.

prompt_templates.title: Create One Lesson Illustration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use image-generator to create one teaching visual for a beginner lesson. Use this story, learning goal, metaphor, colors, and required text: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Failed Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Use image-generator to inspect the latest Gemini output against all six gates. Identify failed gates and send principle-based feedback for one more attempt.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Chapter Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Use image-generator to generate all visuals for this chapter list. Use a new Gemini chat for each image, then download and embed each approved image.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an Interrupted Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use image-generator to read the checkpoint, confirm completed images, resume remaining visuals, update progress, and produce a final batch summary.

output_examples.input: A B1 cloud computing lesson needs an image that explains Kubernetes orchestration with three labeled services.
output: Creative brief sent to Gemini with story, emotional intent, visual metaphor, color semantics, and typography hierarchy.
Result passed spelling, layout, color, typography, teaching clarity, and uniqueness gates.
Image downloaded, placed in the chapter folder, and embedded in the lesson.

output_examples.input: A generated diagram uses the wrong headline size and weak hierarchy.
output_examples.output: Feedback explains that the typography gate failed, identifies the correct key insight, and requests a revised hierarchy from Gemini.

output_examples.input: A batch stops midway after several approved images.
output_examples.output: Checkpoint summary lists completed images, deferred items, folder location, and the next visual to resume.

best_practices: Review creative briefs for sensitive or proprietary content before sending them to Gemini.
Set explicit batch limits, target folders, and approval rules before starting multi-image runs.
Check every image against all six gates before download or embedding.
anti_patterns: Do not treat Markdown prompt examples as executable commands.
Do not send confidential course material to Gemini without approval.
Do not run batch mode without a clear stopping condition and destination folder.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images directly?
faq.answer: No. It guides an agent through Gemini browser automation and quality checks.

faq.question: What tools does it need?
faq.answer: It depends on browser-use and a browser session with access to Gemini.

faq.question: Can it create stock photos?
faq.answer: No. The skill says it is not for stock photos or decorative images.

faq.question: How does it control quality?
faq.answer: It checks spelling, layout, color, typography, teaching clarity, and uniqueness before download.

faq.question: Does it work in batches?
faq.answer: Yes. It defines a batch flow with new chats, progress logs, checkpoints, and final reporting.

faq.question: What data may leave my environment?
faq.answer: Creative briefs and prompts are entered into Gemini, so sensitive content should be reviewed first.
